title: Clean First, Align Later: Benchmarking Preference Data Cleaning for Reliable LLM Alignment
authors_zh: Samuel Yeh、Sharon Li（威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校）
paper_type_zh: 偏好数据清洗基准与训练使用评测研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要在偏好优化之前选择、修正或删除偏好记录的读者。
one_line: PrefCleanBench compares how cleaning preference records changes downstream alignment across data, models, and objectives.
PrefCleanBench 比较偏好记录的不同清洗方式如何影响下游对齐表现。
why: It makes data cleaning a measured training-data decision rather than an untested preprocessing assumption.
inclusion_reason: Establishes how preference-record cleaning decisions should be evaluated before those records are consumed by alignment objectives.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference optimization assumes that a chosen response is genuinely better than its rejected counterpart, but human and model feedback can contain noise, inconsistency, and poor prompts or responses. Many cleaning proposals claim to repair this input, yet their results are usually tied to one dataset, one model, or one optimizer. Practitioners therefore lack a reliable basis for deciding whether a cleaning rule should change the records used for alignment.

PrefCleanBench asks how preference-data cleaning should be compared when the outcome that matters is downstream alignment. It defines a shared protocol that applies cleaning to several preference datasets, trains models with the cleaned and original records, and tests whether any improvement transfers across model families and preference-optimization objectives.

偏好优化假定优选回答确实优于拒选回答，但人工和模型反馈可能包含噪声、不一致，以及质量较差的提示或回答。许多清洗方案声称能修复这些输入，但其结果通常只绑定于一个数据集、一个模型或一个优化器。因此，实践者缺少可靠依据来判断某条清洗规则是否应改变用于对齐的记录。

PrefCleanBench 追问：当真正重要的结果是下游对齐时，应如何比较偏好数据清洗。它定义统一协议，在多个偏好数据集上执行清洗，分别用清洗后与原始记录训练模型，并测试任何改进是否能跨模型家族和偏好优化目标迁移。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper's central move is to treat a cleaning method as a training-data intervention, not as a score that is good in isolation. It groups thirteen existing methods into LLM-as-a-judge, reward-model, and heuristic families, then makes each family produce a cleaned version of the same preference data. The comparison is anchored on what an aligned policy does after training with that version.

Each method has two decisions: how to identify an unreliable pair and whether to remove it or flip its label. PrefCleanBench keeps these decisions visible, varies data sources, base models, and optimization algorithms, and measures both alignment and generalizability. This separates a method that appears effective through a favorable setting from one that consistently improves the data consumed by training.

论文的核心转变是把清洗方法视为一种训练数据干预，而不是孤立地看一个分数是否好。它将十三种已有方法分为大模型评判、奖励模型和启发式三类，然后让每一类对同一份偏好数据产生清洗版本。比较的锚点是：策略使用该版本训练后，实际表现出怎样的对齐行为。

每种方法都包含两个决策：如何识别不可靠的样本对，以及应删除该样本对还是翻转其标签。PrefCleanBench 让这些决策保持可见，改变数据来源、基础模型和优化算法，并同时测量对齐与泛化。这将仅在有利设置下看似有效的方法，与持续改善训练实际使用数据的方法区分开来。

title: Method
方法
html:
The benchmark starts with Anthropic-HH, UltraFeedback, PKU-SafeRLHF, and HelpSteer2. It implements thirteen cleaning approaches: LLM judges, reward-gap and reward-model-voting approaches, and prompt- or difficulty-based heuristics. Each approach marks questionable pairs and produces variants by removing records or, where applicable, flipping preference labels at specified cleaning fractions.

For each original and cleaned variant, the protocol first performs SFT on prompts and chosen answers, then runs preference optimization. The main setting uses Llama-3-8B and DPO; the released code also supports CPO, AOT, KTO, IPO, SLiC, rDPO, and ORPO. It compares model outputs using win-tie rate and held-out average reward, then repeats analyses across backbones and objectives to test generalization.

该基准从 Anthropic-HH、UltraFeedback、PKU-SafeRLHF 和 HelpSteer2 开始。它实现十三种清洗方法：大模型评判、奖励间隔和奖励模型投票方法，以及基于提示或难度的启发式方法。每种方法标记可疑样本对，并通过删除记录或在适用时翻转偏好标签，以指定清洗比例产生不同版本。

对于每个原始版本和清洗版本，协议先在提示与优选回答上进行 SFT，然后执行偏好优化。主要设置使用 Llama-3-8B 和 DPO；公开代码还支持 CPO、AOT、KTO、IPO、SLiC、rDPO 和 ORPO。它用胜平率和保留奖励平均值比较模型输出，然后跨基础模型和目标重复分析以测试泛化。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports a controlled DPO comparison over four preference datasets and evaluates thirteen cleaning approaches. Its main table shows that no one technique wins every dataset and metric, while the choice to remove or flip a flagged label materially changes outcomes. The authors find that using multiple judges to identify unreliable records and removing those records often produces stronger win-tie rate and reward results than relying on a single judge or simply flipping labels.

The evaluation uses a GPT-4o judge for win-tie rate, a held-out reward model for average reward, alternative reward models in appendices, and a human comparison on a sampled Anthropic-HH subset. The code repository exposes the processing, cleaning, training, generation, and evaluation steps. The evidence is therefore strong for the benchmarked settings, but it does not establish a universally best cleaner or guarantee that its automatic judgments match every deployment's preferences.

论文报告了跨四个偏好数据集的受控 DPO 比较，并评估十三种清洗方法。其主表显示，没有一种技术在所有数据集和指标上都取胜，而删除还是翻转被标记标签的选择会实质性改变结果。作者发现，用多个评判器识别不可靠记录并删除这些记录，通常比依赖单一评判器或仅翻转标签带来更强的胜平率和奖励结果。

评估使用 GPT-4o 评判胜平率、使用保留奖励模型测量平均奖励，并在附录中使用替代奖励模型，还在人类标注的 Anthropic-HH 抽样子集上进行比较。代码仓库公开了处理、清洗、训练、生成和评估步骤。因此，证据对已基准测试的设置很强，但它并未证明存在普适最优的清洗器，也不能保证其自动判断符合每一种部署的偏好。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior work proposes individual rules for detecting bad preference pairs, but usually measures each rule inside its own experimental design. PrefCleanBench changes the contribution from another cleaning rule to a shared evaluation surface: the same kinds of records are cleaned, trained on, and evaluated under a common downstream protocol. It also makes the corrective action—removal versus label flipping—a first-class variable.

The novelty is thus comparative and operational rather than a new preference objective. The benchmark unifies thirteen methods across three families, four source datasets, several training algorithms, and multiple backbones, with modular released code. It shows that preprocessing decisions belong to the alignment-training pipeline and must be judged by their effect on the policy that consumes the cleaned records.

既有工作提出了识别低质量偏好对的单独规则，但通常只在各自的实验设计中测量这些规则。PrefCleanBench 将贡献从又一条清洗规则转变为共享评测界面：同类记录在共同的下游协议中被清洗、训练和评估。它还把校正动作——删除还是翻转标签——设为一等变量。

因此，新意在于比较性和操作性，而不是新的偏好目标。该基准在三类方法、四个源数据集、若干训练算法和多个基础模型上统一十三种方法，并发布模块化代码。它表明，预处理决策属于对齐训练流水线，必须依据其对使用清洗记录的策略所产生的效果来判断。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The benchmark inevitably inherits assumptions from its upstream datasets, GPT-4o judge, reward models, cleaning fractions, and selected base models. A method can benefit from a particular judge or reward model while encoding its bias, and choosing the best removal fraction after evaluation can overstate deploy-time gains. The paper tests broad combinations but not every domain, language, preference policy, or high-cost human-feedback workflow; teams must therefore preserve data splits, account for API and compute cost, and validate any cleaning rule against their own target behavior rather than treating the benchmark ranking as a universal prescription.
该基准不可避免地继承上游数据集、GPT-4o 评判器、奖励模型、清洗比例和所选基础模型的假设。一种方法可能因特定评判器或奖励模型而受益，同时编码其偏见；在评估后选择最佳删除比例也可能夸大部署时的收益。论文测试了广泛组合，但没有覆盖每个领域、语言、偏好政策或高成本人工反馈流程；因此团队必须保留数据划分，考虑 API 与计算成本，并根据自身目标行为验证任何清洗规则，而不能将基准排名视为普适处方。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work to choose an evaluation plan before adopting a preference-data cleaning rule. It supplies a taxonomy, executable implementations, and a clean-versus-original training comparison that can be adapted to a local preference corpus. It is especially useful for teams deciding whether noisy pairs should be removed or relabeled, which cleaning signal is worth its cost, and whether an apparent DPO improvement survives a change in backbone or optimization objective.
应在采用偏好数据清洗规则之前使用这项工作来选择评估方案。它提供分类法、可执行实现，以及清洗版与原始版的训练比较，可适配到本地偏好语料。它尤其适合帮助团队决定应删除还是重标带噪声的样本对、哪一种清洗信号值得其成本，以及表面上的 DPO 改进是否能在更换基础模型或优化目标后仍然成立。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the taxonomy and evaluation protocol before the results table. Distinguish the signal used to flag a record from the action taken after flagging it, and check whether the score is computed with a model that later appears in evaluation. Then reproduce one dataset and one optimizer using the repository, hold the cleaning fraction fixed before final evaluation, and report both data retained or corrected and downstream alignment results. This avoids confusing an attractive cleaning score with a demonstrated training benefit.
应在阅读结果表之前先阅读分类法和评估协议。区分用于标记记录的信号与标记后采取的动作，并检查该分数是否由后来出现在评估中的模型计算。随后使用仓库复现一个数据集和一个优化器，在最终评估前固定清洗比例，并同时报告保留或校正的数据以及下游对齐结果。这能避免将一个看起来很好的清洗分数误认为已经被证明的训练收益。
